defensiveAbilities.name: Boneshard Burst
defensiveAbilities.description: When a clacking skull swarm is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it erupts in an explosion of foul energy and bone fragments in a 30ft Burst, dealing 2d12 Piercing Damage|options:area-damage]{2d12 piercing damage and 2d12 void damage} (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Chattering Teeth
defensiveAbilities.description: 60 feet. A clacking skull swarm emits a cacophony of chattering. A creature entering or beginning its turn within the area must succeed at a DC 29 Will Saving Throw save or become Confused for 1 round. A creature that successfully saves is immune to that swarm's chattering teeth for 24 hours. The swarm can stop or resume this ability as a free action.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shrieking Scream
offensiveAbilities.description:
The clacking skull swarm emits a terrifying, painful scream that deals 10d6 Sonic Damage damage to all creatures in a 30ft Cone (Basic DC 29 Will Saving Throw save). A creature that fails this save is also Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

The swarm can't use Frightening Scream again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarming Gnaw
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 4d8 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save).
